gen-dafont-azonix-gf-sintony: Wide, crisp, outline-like letters up top. Sintony follows in sans-serif, with a chunky, tall midzone that keeps every curve smooth and unclogged beneath Azonix's commanding headings.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-sofia-sans: Authoritative Azonix sits up top, with capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Sofia Sans below is rounded, open-sided and stencil-tall in the lowercase, and if the heading shrinks, Azonix's wide mouths still stay crisp.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Azonix heads the pair with wide-mouthed letters and capitals only slightly above lowercase, so words take a moment to knit together. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed answers with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and a big visible entrance into each curve.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-stack-sans-headline: Wide, outlined and slow to knit together. Stack Sans Headline brings a deep middle band and a monoline skeleton, which gives Azonix's commanding headings a steadier, more approachable partner.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-stack-sans-notch: Commanding, wide and barely taller in capitals than lowercase, Azonix leads. Stack Sans Notch brings open curves you can see right into and rod-stock strokes, giving the heading a sturdy, big-bodied partner.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-stack-sans-text: Authoritative Azonix leads with wide mouths and capitals barely above its lowercase. And Stack Sans Text brings a marker-like constant line, with curve endings kept well apart and big-bodied lowercase that gives the pair its strongest quality.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-sulphur-point: Commanding Azonix has wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk, though its words need a moment to knit back together. Sulphur Point's open gaps are the draw.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-tiktok-sans: Wire-thin strokes, wide mouths, commanding presence: that is Azonix. And TikTok Sans in sans-serif lifts its x-height close to the cap height, with a spacious opening on the c that keeps a longer passage moving.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-ubuntu-sans: Azonix draws its wide, crisp letters like outlines in a single width, capitals barely above lowercase. Ubuntu Sans adds sans-serif tubular strokes.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-vend-sans: Azonix is all wide mouths and outlined, commanding capitals. It excels at announcing a line, while Vend Sans, a ruler-drawn sans-serif with unclosed terminals and an x-height filling the line, does its best work in the text beneath.
